name: Minimum Checkout Amount
author: Marco G

sections.description:
The Minimum Checkout Amount plugin allows you to enforce a minimum checkout amount on your WooCommerce store. It ensures that customers cannot proceed to checkout unless their cart total meets the specified minimum amount The plugin is fully customizable, integrates seamlessly into WooCommerce settings, and supports multilingual websites.

Key features:
– Set a minimum checkout amount
– Select excluding taxes or including taxes.
– Display notices on the cart page and redirect de checkout page
– Customize messages for error notifications.
– Fully integrated into WooCommerce settings.
– Lightweight and optimized for performance.
– Multilingual support with translation-ready strings.

This plugin is ideal for B2B stores, wholesale businesses, or any WooCommerce site that requires a minimum checkout threshold.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the minimum-checkout-amount folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Minimum Checkout Amount to configure the plugin.
  4. Set the minimum checkout amount and customize the display options as needed.
sections.faq:
How do I set the minimum checkout amount?

Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Minimum Checkout Amount and enter the desired minimum amount in the “Minimum Amount” field. By default the calclul is set without tax

Can I customize the error messages?

Yes, the plugin uses default messages, but they are translation-ready. You can translate them into your desired language using .po files or a translation plugin.

Does this plugin work with taxes included?

yes, the plugin calculates the minimum checkout amount with taxes. In the settings tab check Include taxes in the minimum amount calculation..

Can I apply the minimum checkout amount to specific user roles or categories?

Not currently, but this feature can be added with custom development. Check the plugin’s documentation for suggestions on extending its functionality.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest version of WooCommerce?

Yes, it is tested with WooCommerce 10.X. and WordPress 6.8.
